states.ENCODED: GetPathType is explicitly present and is one of the accepted canonical codes 2, 3 or 4.
states.UNENCODED: GetPathType is omitted. This is a source-data gap and must not be replaced by inference.

supplementalEvidencePolicy.rule: Preserve source text and presence exactly, but do not parse keywords or prose into acquisition categories in Stage 1. Exact history for UNENCODED skins requires a separately verified supplemental dictionary in a later stage.

prohibitions: Do not parse GetPathDesc keywords to convert UNENCODED into an acquisition category.
Do not use ConfigDataHeroSkinInfo.Score as acquisition evidence.
Do not use skin ID patterns, asset paths, store UI order or filenames as acquisition evidence.
Do not introduce GetPathType codes outside the accepted canonical codes 2, 3 and 4 in the 540-record Stage 1 population.
Do not add KR/CN release status, KR_FUTURE or displayTarget in Stage 1-4.
downstreamRule: Later verified acquisition enrichment may add supplemental display history, but it must preserve this Stage 1 source state and distinguish verified enrichment from ConfigData GetPathType authority.
